item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo invests in Kalshi, a day after fans traded over $23 million on his NBA future
item.description: Kalshi said Milwaukee Bucks star Giannis Antetokounmpo will partner with the company on marketing, live events, and other activities.

item.title: I joined a decluttering challenge and got rid of 496 items in a month. I made a point to not throw anything in the trash.
item.description: A mom and children's book author explains how a 31-day minimalist decluttering challenge helped her reduce stress and rethink her stuff.

item.title: Washington Post publisher Will Lewis is out days after sweeping layoffs
item.description: Will Lewis, the CEO of The Washington Post, announced his departure from the beleaguered paper on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Read the memos sent to staff announcing Washington Post publisher Will Lewis' resignation
item.description: Washington Post publisher Will Lewis stepped down on Saturday after two years. Chief financial officer Jeff D'Onofrio will succeed him.

item.title: Hims & Hers removes a knock-off weight loss drug days after introducing it
item.description: Hims & Hers said it would stop selling its new compounded semaglutide pill after "constructive conversations with stakeholders across the industry."

item.title: Jeff Bezos made a mess at the Washington Post. It's up to him to fix it.
item.description: The world's fourth-richest man promised to save the Washington Post. Time for him to step up and do it.

item.title: 'Today' show host Savannah Guthrie's mother Nancy has gone missing. Here's what we know.
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, mother of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie, has been missing since February 1. Here's what we know about the case.

item.title: Washington Post union calls for Jeff Bezos to sell the paper after CEO resigns
item.description: In a statement released Saturday following the ouster of Washington Post CEO Will Lewis, the Post's union called for Jeff Bezos to sell the paper.

item.title: Jeff Bezos speaks out about The Washington Post for the first time since mass layoffs and focuses on 'data'
item.description: Washington Post owner Jeff Bezos has put out his first statement since the paper's cuts. He said "data tells us what is valuable and where to focus."

item.title: Savannah Guthrie says 'we will pay' for mother's return in video plea to potential abductor
item.description: Savannah Guthrie posted a cryptic video on Instagram, stating that the family had received a "message" and that they "will pay" for mother's return.
